note: Care-transition, feed-timeliness, year-over-year volume and coded-diagnosis lookups.

rules.description: Hours from an ADT event to our receipt of its notification (median and mean)
rules.pattern: ^how (?:long|many hours|many days) after (?:an? |the )?{event} do we (?:typically |usually |normally )?(?:receive|get) the adt (?:notification|message|feed|alert)s? {period?}$

plan.query: WITH x AS (SELECT 24.0 * (julianday(json_extract(payload, '$.available_time')) - julianday(json_extract(payload, '$.event_time'))) AS v FROM record WHERE stream = 'adt' AND json_extract(payload, '$.event') = '{event.value}' AND json_extract(payload, '$.event_time') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(payload, '$.available_time') IS NOT NULL AND {period.where:event_date}), r AS (SELECT v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v) AS rn, count(*) OVER () AS n FROM x) SELECT '{event.value}' AS adt_event, max(n) AS notifications, round(avg(CASE WHEN rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2) THEN v END), 2) AS median_hours, round(avg(v), 2) AS mean_hours, round(max(v), 2) AS max_hours FROM r
plan.purpose: Hours from the ADT {event.value} event time to the time the notification was available to us (median, mean, max)

rules.description: Share of ED visits or discharges followed by an outgoing phone contact with the patient within N days

plan.query: WITH e AS (SELECT encounter_id, patient_id, coalesce(end_date, event_date) AS d FROM visit WHERE {index.pred} AND event_date IS NOT NULL AND {period.where:event_date}), c AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, event_date FROM record WHERE stream = 'telephone_messages' AND json_extract(payload, '$.direction') = 'outgoing') SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN e.encounter_id END) / nullif(count(DISTINCT e.encounter_id), 0), 2) FROM e LEFT JOIN c ON c.patient_id = e.patient_id AND c.event_date BETWEEN substr(e.d, 1, 10) AND date(substr(e.d, 1, 10), '+{n.value} days')
plan.purpose: Percent of {index.value} with an outgoing telephone contact to the same patient from the visit (or discharge) date through {n.value} days after

rules.description: Received records of a service per 1,000 roster patients, this year to date vs the same span last year and all of last year

plan.query: WITH n AS (SELECT count(*) AS roster FROM patient), y AS (SELECT CAST(substr(date('{as_of}'), 1, 4) AS integer) AS cur) SELECT label AS period, records, round(1000.0 * records / (SELECT roster FROM n), 1) AS per_1000 FROM (SELECT 'last year (full)' AS label, 1 AS k, count(*) AS records FROM record WHERE stream = '{service.stream}' AND substr(event_date, 1, 4) = CAST((SELECT cur FROM y) - 1 AS text) UNION ALL SELECT 'last year to same date', 2, count(*) FROM record WHERE stream = '{service.stream}' AND event_date BETWEEN CAST((SELECT cur FROM y) - 1 AS text) || '-01-01' AND date('{as_of}', '-1 year') UNION ALL SELECT 'this year to date', 3, count(*) FROM record WHERE stream = '{service.stream}' AND event_date BETWEEN substr('{as_of}', 1, 4) || '-01-01' AND '{as_of}') ORDER BY k
plan.purpose: {service.value} per 1,000 roster patients: all of last year, last year through the same date, and this year to date (not annualised)

rules.description: Patients with an ICD-10 code (or category range) on any claim, by attributed practice

plan.query: WITH dx AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.patient_id FROM claim c, json_each(c.diagnosis_codes) j WHERE c.diagnosis_codes IS NOT NULL AND {code.pred:j.value} AND {period.where:c.service_date}) SELECT pcp_practice_id AS practice, count(*) AS members, sum(patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM dx)) AS members_with_code, round(100.0 * sum(patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM dx)) / count(*), 2) AS pct FROM patient GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
